title: Data Cache is moving to Runtime Cache
summary: Data Cache is exiting beta and moving to Runtime Cache . Next.js fetch caching and unstable_cache will switch over on every version without code changes. On Pro, each project and environment gets its own Runtime Cache storage allocation, with 8x the space of Data Cache’s previous team-wide pool. Enterprise projects get 10x their previous Data Cache storage. Once your team migrates, Data Cache reads and writes that were previously unbilled are charged at Runtime Cache pricing
